script_text: Leo, this week is no warm-up; Jupiter enters Cancer, your 12th House, while your ruler, the Sun, lights Gemini in your 11th. Early week, Tuesday is strongest for love; Wednesday is volatile because the Sagittarius Full Moon in your 5th House opposes the Sun, making romance public, while Mars in Aries trines Jupiter for career moves. The mid-week turn is Wednesday night, when the Moon enters Capricorn and your Fire element shifts from applause to deadlines. Thursday is rougher because the Capricorn Moon squares Mars in your 9th, irritating clients. Late week, the Aquarius Moon conjuncts Pluto in your 7th House, so a partner tells the truth; Sunday’s Pisces Moon in your 8th tightens money boundaries. Friday is your power day because Venus sextiles Mars and your 11th House lights up. Wednesday is your worst day because the Full Moon stirs ego clashes. Pick one spotlight. Follow for daily updates.
